A-80 at a glance

The A-80 is a floating and wall-crawling underwater robot for contact cleaning of trash racks, intakes and submerged surfaces. Manufacturer figures: 100 kg vehicle weight, 300 m depth rating, 15 kg payload and two HD cameras, with brush or cavitation water-jet cleaning modules and external tethered power.

FAQ

A-80 questions.

What does the A-80 clean?

Adhered deposits and fouling on submerged surfaces such as intake trash racks, using a brush or cavitation water-jet module. It is not designed to extract logs or large floating debris.

Does trash-rack cleaning need divers or draining?

The manufacturer’s Baihetan reference describes cleaning without draining, stopping the facility or sending people underwater. Confirm the same conditions for your intake.

What support equipment does the A-80 need?

A control station, tether and power supply, plus the pump and hose for water-jet cleaning. These should be itemised in the quotation together with the selected cleaning module.

How do I get a price for the A-80?

Price depends on the configuration: sensors, tether length, tools and support equipment. Send a short project brief or email us, and we will reply with the questions needed for an itemised quotation.
